span.p:
Add capacity first.
Writes stop at full ratio.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Find the object in the cluster log,
map its name to a ShardPost class

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ftx/GEN/dN or pN: reshard it
(plan -due-only fts_layout, raise a cap)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Which OSD? ceph osd perf.
Pause heavy jobs, check disks

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Wait for recovery,
no migrations or sweeps now

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Logs: account locked?
store errors? Ceph latency?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Contention on one class:
fts, registry or mbox

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A path still lists:
check modes and backfills

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Raise the cap or
plan fts_rebuild

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read the job result,
repair with scrub classes
